definitions.explanation: Lacking courtesy or respect. A somewhat formal or literary way of describing rude behavior.

examples.japanese: {無礼|ぶれい}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とった。
{無礼|ぶれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{承知|しょうち}→承知：02086_shouchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I say this knowing it may be rude.
examples.notes: A set phrase used before saying something potentially offensive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目上|めうえ}→目上：03804_meue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{無礼|ぶれい}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: Using disrespectful language toward a superior is unacceptable.

notes:
USAGE: More formal and literary than ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧ (rude, impolite). {無礼|ぶれい} carries a stronger, more serious tone and implies a deeper breach of social etiquette.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無礼|ぶれい}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: rude attitude
- {無礼|ぶれい}な⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧: rude behavior
- {無礼|ぶれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to behave rudely
- {無礼|ぶれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{承知|しょうち}→承知：02086_shouchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: knowing it may be rude
- {無礼|ぶれい}{講|こう}: a drinking party where rank is set aside

CONTRAST: {無礼|ぶれい} (rude, stronger) vs. ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧ (impolite, milder/everyday).
